notes.title: 🥣 Welcome to Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror! 🖤
notes.content: [h3][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620239/48909de53f0166b7d7150361ba10b555ae8caa59.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620239/f31f4ced008caf611dcff2323e3f04c16b04c942.png"][/img][/url][/h3][p]Hello, fellow wanderers of the eerie and the cozy! 👻[/p][p]We’re thrilled to welcome all our new followers to the world of [b]Corbaci[/b], where simmering soups and unsettling stories blend into a unique horror experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]🍲 What’s Cooking?[/h3][p]In our latest update, we’ve stirred the pot with:[/p][list][*][p][b]Enhanced Cinematic Flow[/b]: Smoother transitions and immersive storytelling to keep you on edge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Tweaks[/b]: Adjusted effects for a more comfortable experience—though the eerie ambiance remains intact.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Addressed camera glitches and other minor issues to ensure a seamless journey.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧠 What’s Next?[/h3][p]The full release is simmering and will be served in [b]Q4 2025[/b]. Until then, we invite you to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Wishlist[/b] the game to stay updated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Join the Community[/b]: Share your thoughts, theories, and screenshots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explore the Prologue[/b]: Available now on Steam to get a taste of the mystery.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for being part of this hauntingly cozy adventure. We can’t wait to share more with you soon![/p][p]Stay spooky and stay cozy. 🖤[/p][p]— The Corbaci Team[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Welcome New Followers! | 欢迎新关注者！
notes.content:
[h3][/h3][p]Hey everyone – and a warm welcome to all our new followers![/p][p]The full release of [b]CORBACI[/b] is just around the corner, and we’re incredibly excited to show you what’s cooking.
We’ve been hard at work polishing the experience based on your feedback. Here’s a quick look at what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]🛠️ Fixed a few nasty camera bugs (no more spinning heads – unless they're [i]meant[/i] to spin...)[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 Reduced the brain-melting visual effects (but you can still turn them back on if you dare)[/p][/*][*][p]🎥 Improved the cinematic experience and overall flow[/p][/*][*][p]🍜 Tweaked some soup secrets… but those you’ll have to discover yourself[/p][/*][/list][p]This game is made with a lot of love and a little bit of unease – just the way we like it. Thanks for being part of this strange little journey.[/p][p]Wishlisting, sharing, and feedback are all super appreciated.
More updates (and creepy stuff) coming soon.[/p][p]— The CORBACI Team[/p]

notes.title: Flies Are Here, and You’re Finally Visible
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=r1uzAd05xcI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
New Update: Flies Are Here, and You’re Finally Visible

A small but atmospheric update has just been added to Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror.

Fly System Added
Flies now buzz around specific areas in the kitchen. They react to the environment and add a layer of unease to the space. You’ll see them. You’ll hear them.

👁️ First-Person Body Visibility
Your character is now visible from the first-person view. You can see your body, your steps, and feel more present in the environment.

📹 The video above shows this new update in action. Check it out and let us know what you think.

More is cooking. Stay tuned.

🫗
– The Corbaci Team

notes.title: I Just Released the Official Trailer
notes.content:
Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror

Hey,
I just dropped the first official trailer for Corbaci, and honestly… I’m both excited and a little terrified to finally show it to the world.

This game means a lot to me. It’s retro, it’s weird, it’s quiet  until it’s not.
There’s something about flickering lights, VHS vibes, and eerie silence that I just love.
Corbaci is my way of bringing all of that into one creepy, cozy experience.

If that sounds like your kind of thing, check out the trailer.
And if you like what you see, wishlist it, it helps more than you think.

Thanks for taking the time.
Really.
